name: rollback-demo-guardian
description: Valida a saude do demo-app apos deploy e apos rollback.

objectives.name: Taxa de erro HTTP (%)
objectives.description: Percentual de requisicoes com falha no demo-app durante a janela de validacao. Principal gatilho para o rollback.
objectives.dqlQuery:
timeseries { errors = sum(dt.service.request.failure_count), total = sum(dt.service.request.count) },
  filter: { k8s.namespace.name == "rollback-demo" and k8s.cluster.name == "rollback-demo-cluster" }
| fieldsAdd error_rate = 100 * arraySum(errors) / arraySum(total)
| fields error_rate

objectives.name: Latencia p95 (ms)
objectives.description: Tempo de resposta no percentil 95 do demo-app. Detecta regressao de performance mesmo sem erros.
objectives.dqlQuery:
timeseries p95 = percentile(dt.service.request.response_time, 95),
  filter: { k8s.namespace.name == "rollback-demo" and k8s.cluster.name == "rollback-demo-cluster" }
| fieldsAdd p95_ms = arrayMax(p95) / 1000
| fields p95_ms

objectives.name: Throughput (req/min)
objectives.description: Requisicoes por minuto recebidas pelo demo-app. Valor baixo indica servico fora do ar ou sem trafego, e reprova a validacao.
objectives.dqlQuery:
timeseries req = sum(dt.service.request.count, rate: 1m),
  filter: { k8s.namespace.name == "rollback-demo" and k8s.cluster.name == "rollback-demo-cluster" }
| fieldsAdd requests_per_min = arrayAvg(req)
| fields requests_per_min

objectives.name: Uso de memoria (%)
objectives.description: Pico de memoria em relacao ao limite de 128Mi do container. Detecta vazamento antes de causar OOMKill.
objectives.dqlQuery:
timeseries mem = avg(dt.kubernetes.container.memory_working_set),
  filter: { k8s.namespace.name == "rollback-demo" and k8s.cluster.name == "rollback-demo-cluster" }
| fieldsAdd mem_pct = arrayMax(mem) / (128 * 1024 * 1024) * 100
| fields mem_pct
